title: Negation of a probability expectation
statement: Let $Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $Omega$, and let $f:Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The expectation of $-f$ under $\pi$ equals the negative of the expectation of $f$ under $\pi$.
